title: FEATURE — Phase 1.5 readiness: gate projection + manual post queue + post-now CLI

tasks.title: Extend audit-gate-count.ts with Phase 1.5 readiness projection
tasks.description: Add pace projection: days until Apr 7, posts/day needed, pace assessment (on-track/at-risk/critical). Add to both JSON output and console summary.

tasks.title: Create manual-post-queue.ts — queue manager for pending posts
tasks.description: CLI tool: list/add/remove posts from a queue file (workspace/scs001/post-queue.jsonl). Commands: list, add <video_id> <title>, remove <video_id>, next (show next to post).

tasks.title: Create post-now.ts — manual posting CLI with dry-run fallback
tasks.description: Posts a video to TikTok via API if TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is set. Falls back to dry-run mode (logs to manual-posts.jsonl with method=dry-run). Accepts video_id as argument.

acceptance_criteria: audit-gate-count.ts shows pace projection in output
post-now.ts runs in dry-run mode when no token, logs to manual-posts.jsonl
